ruleDefinitions.name: CurrentVersion NT Autorun Keys Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion.*") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Winlogon\\\\VmApplet.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Winlogon\\\\Userinit.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Winlogon\\\\Taskman.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Winlogon\\\\Shell.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Winlogon\\\\GpExtensions.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Winlogon\\\\AppSetup.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Winlogon\\\\AlternateShells\\\\AvailableShells.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\IconServiceLib.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Appinit\\_Dlls.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Image\\ File\\ Execution\\ Options.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Font\\ Drivers.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Drivers32.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Run.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Load.*"))) AND  NOT (Details = "\(Empty\)" OR (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Image\\ File\\ Execution\\ Options\\\\.*") AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableExceptionChainValidation$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\MitigationOptions$"))) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\svchost\.exe" AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Winlogon\\\\GPExtensions\\\\\\{827D319E\\-6EAC\\-11D2\\-A4EA\\-00C04F79F83A\\}\\\\PreviousPolicyAreas.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Winlogon\\\\GPExtensions\\\\\\{827D319E\\-6EAC\\-11D2\\-A4EA\\-00C04F79F83A\\}\\\\MaxNoGPOListChangesInterval.*")) AND (Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000009\)" OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x000003c0\)")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\RuntimeBroker\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\runtimebroker\\\.exe\\\\Microsoft\\\.Windows\\\.ShellExperienceHost.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\\\Temp\\\\") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\MicrosoftEdgeUpdate\\\.exe$")) OR ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\ClickToRunStore\\\\HKLM\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\ClickToRun\\\\REGISTRY\\\\MACHINE\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\.*")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Office\\root\\integration\\integrator\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Microsoft\ Office\\root\\integration\\integrator\.exe")) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\ClickToRun\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\ClickToRun\\\\Updates\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\OfficeClickToRun\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\ngen\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\OneDrive\\\\StandaloneUpdater\\\\OneDriveSetup\\\.exe$") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\RunOnce\\\\Delete\\ Cached\\ Update\\ Binary$") AND Details = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\\\cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/q\\ \\/c\\ del\\ \\/q\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Users\\\\") AND Details = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\OneDrive\\\\Update\\\\OneDriveSetup\\\.exe\\$")))
